moments.title: Europa League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The UEFA Europa League 2026/27 league phase begins today, Wednesday September 16, with British teams Sunderland, Bournemouth, and Crystal Palace all in action this week.

angles.name: Kick-off excitement
angles.copy: Europe's second-tier club competition is back! The UEFA Europa League kicks off today, with three British sides fighting for glory. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Sunderland's start
angles.copy: Sunderland begin their Europa League campaign today against AZ Alkmaar. Can the Black Cats make a strong start in Europe? Tune in!

angles.name: Bournemouth & Palace
angles.copy: Tomorrow sees Bournemouth take on Real Sociedad and Crystal Palace face Lech Poznan in their opening Europa League fixtures. Good luck, lads!

moments.title: England Cricket vs Sri Lanka
moments.blurb: England Men's cricket team continues their white-ball series against Sri Lanka this week, with the 2nd IT20 in Cardiff tomorrow, followed by the 3rd IT20 in Manchester on Saturday, and then ODIs starting next week.

angles.name: Cardiff IT20
angles.copy: Big cricket in Cardiff tomorrow! England take on Sri Lanka in the 2nd Vitality IT20 at Sophia Gardens. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Series Decider?
angles.copy: It's a huge week for England cricket! The T20 series against Sri Lanka could be decided this week, with matches in Cardiff and Manchester.

angles.name: Manchester final T20
angles.copy: The 3rd T20 between England and Sri Lanka is at Emirates Old Trafford on Saturday. Will England seal the series in Manchester?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its pre-recorded launch show on Saturday, September 19, on BBC One, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly returns
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing returns this Saturday with its glittering launch show. Who's excited for the new pairings?

angles.name: New hosts
angles.copy: A new era for Strictly! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe take over hosting duties this series. Big shoes to fill!

angles.name: Launch night prep
angles.copy: Dust off your sequins! Strictly Come Dancing is back on Saturday night. Who do you think will be this year's dark horse?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: The 17th series of The Great British Bake Off begins on Tuesday, September 22, at 8pm on Channel 4, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off is back
angles.copy: On your marks, get set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off returns next Tuesday. Who's ready for some soggy bottoms and Hollywood handshakes?

angles.name: New judge Nigella
angles.copy: Exciting news in the Bake Off tent! Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a new judge. What do you make of the change?

angles.name: Tuesday night treat
angles.copy: Your Tuesday nights are sorted! The new series of Bake Off starts next week. Time to get those ovens pre-heated!

moments.title: Autumn Equinox
moments.blurb: The astronomical Autumn Equinox in the UK occurs on Wednesday, September 23, at 01:05 BST, marking the official start of autumn and when nights begin to be longer than days.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! The Autumn Equinox arrives next Wednesday, officially ushering in the new season. Get ready for cosy nights and pumpkin spice!

angles.name: Longer nights begin
angles.copy: From next Wednesday, the nights will officially start getting longer than the days. Time to embrace the autumnal vibes! What's your favourite thing about autumn?

angles.name: Stonehenge Equinox
angles.copy: For those seeking a unique experience, English Heritage offers free access to Stonehenge for the Autumn Equinox next Wednesday. A truly ancient tradition!

moments.title: Gallagher Premiership Rugby Season Starts
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Gallagher Premiership Rugby season kicks off next weekend, September 25-27, with Harlequins v Bath and Northampton Saints v Newcastle Red Bulls on Friday, and Exeter Chiefs v Gloucester on Saturday.

angles.name: Rugby's back!
angles.copy: Get ready for some crunching tackles! The Gallagher Premiership Rugby season kicks off next weekend. Who's your pick for the title?

angles.name: Exeter Chiefs start
angles.copy: Our very own Exeter Chiefs begin their Premiership campaign at home to Gloucester next Saturday! Big cheers needed at Sandy Park!

angles.name: Opening weekend clashes
angles.copy: Harlequins vs Bath and Northampton Saints vs Newcastle Red Bulls headline the opening Friday of the Premiership season. What a start!

moments.title: Niall Horan in Birmingham
moments.blurb: Niall Horan brings his 'The Show' Live On Tour to Utilita Arena Birmingham on Tuesday, September 22.

angles.name: Niall in Brum
angles.copy: Niall Horan is bringing 'The Show' to Utilita Arena Birmingham next Tuesday! Who's excited to see the former One Direction star?

angles.name: Big Birmingham gig
angles.copy: One of the biggest gigs this week: Niall Horan live in Birmingham next Tuesday! Get ready for a night of pop anthems.

angles.name: Get your tickets
angles.copy: Still time to grab tickets for Niall Horan's Birmingham show next week! Don't miss out on seeing 'The Show' live!

moments.title: Liam Gallagher's 54th Birthday
moments.blurb: Liam Gallagher, iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, turns 54 on Sunday, September 21.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Rock 'n' Roll Star alert! Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on Sunday. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

angles.name: Still a rock icon
angles.copy: 54 years young for Liam Gallagher this weekend! Still one of the most distinctive voices in British music. Absolute legend.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Sunday is Liam Gallagher's birthday! Let's get 'Mad for it' and celebrate one of the UK's greatest rock frontmen. What song are you playing?

moments.title: Bruce Springsteen's 77th Birthday
moments.blurb: American rock legend Bruce Springsteen, known as 'The Boss', celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, September 23.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Boss
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to 'The Boss', Bruce Springsteen, next Wednesday! What's your all-time favourite Springsteen anthem?

angles.name: Still rocking at 77
angles.copy: Bruce Springsteen turns 77 next week and is still one of the most electrifying live performers. An absolute icon of rock music.

angles.name: Classic Hits legend
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible career of Bruce Springsteen next Wednesday for his 77th birthday! From 'Born to Run' to 'Dancing in the Dark', pure class.

moments.title: Will Smith's 58th Birthday
moments.blurb: Actor, rapper, and global superstar Will Smith celebrates his 58th birthday on Saturday, September 25.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Will
angles.copy: Get jiggy with it! Will Smith turns 58 this Saturday. From Fresh Prince to global movie star, what's your favourite Will Smith moment?

angles.name: Big Willie Style
angles.copy: Celebrating the one and only Will Smith's 58th birthday this weekend! Still bringing the 'Big Willie Style' to everything he does.

angles.name: 90s Icon
angles.copy: Will Smith's 58th on Saturday! A true 90s icon, whether he was rapping or making us laugh on TV. What's your favourite Fresh Prince episode?

moments.title: Catherine Zeta Jones' 57th Birthday
moments.blurb: Welsh actress and Hollywood star Catherine Zeta Jones celebrates her 57th birthday on Saturday, September 25.

angles.name: Happy Birthday CZJ
angles.copy: Our very own Hollywood superstar, Catherine Zeta Jones, turns 57 this Saturday! Sending huge Welsh birthday wishes to the legend!

angles.name: Welsh Icon
angles.copy: Penblwydd Hapus to the incredible Catherine Zeta Jones, who celebrates her 57th birthday on Saturday! A true Welsh icon on the global stage.

angles.name: From Swansea to Hollywood
angles.copy: From Swansea to Hollywood, Catherine Zeta Jones turns 57 this weekend! What's your favourite film she's starred in?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The UK's Official Singles Chart Top 40 is due for its weekly update this Friday, September 19, revealing who has the UK's number one song.

angles.name: New Number One?
angles.copy: Who will be crowned the UK's Number One this week? The Official Singles Chart is updated this Friday! Any predictions?

angles.name: Chart Battle
angles.copy: The battle for the top spot continues! The Official Singles Chart update is just two days away. Who are you rooting for?

angles.name: Friday Chart Reveal
angles.copy: Friday means new music and a new Official Singles Chart! Will there be a brand new Number One? Tune in to find out!

moments.title: Thompson Twins' Tom Bailey at The O2
moments.blurb: Tom Bailey of Thompson Twins brings his 'Set' tour to The O2 Arena in London on Saturday, September 19.

angles.name: 80s Icon in London
angles.copy: Step back into the 80s! Tom Bailey of Thompson Twins is live at The O2 London this Saturday. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Doctor! Doctor!
angles.copy: It's an 80s party at The O2 this Saturday as Tom Bailey performs Thompson Twins classics! 'Doctor! Doctor!' is a must-hear.

angles.name: Retro Saturday Night
angles.copy: Fancy a retro Saturday night? Tom Bailey is bringing the Thompson Twins hits to London's O2 this weekend!
